auxiliary_ratio: Raw connected_compact_enhancement is a ratio to an iid reference built from the inclusive zero-pair marginal. It is NOT a universal identical-fermion cumulant or an independent binding proof.
source_strengths: Actual canonical CAR norm, local-field projection norm and word-Galerkin projection norm are DISTINCT. Normalized shifted H-word component weights are basis metrics, not unscaled emission probabilities or complete pole residues.
